description: This file declares functions related to the lowering of tuple structures within TorchScript JIT graphs. It includes functions to simplify or remove tuples from computational graphs, which is useful for graph transformations and interoperability with other formats such as ONNX.

methods.name: LowerSimpleTuples
methods.description: Removes matched TupleConstruct and TupleUnpack nodes, simplifying tuples in the graph while preserving tuples across control flow constructs.

methods.name: LowerAllTuples
methods.description: Removes all tuples from the graph, raising an error if some cannot be eliminated, primarily used for preparing graphs for ONNX conversion.

methods.name: LowerSimpleTuples (Block*)
methods.description: Overload that applies the tuple lowering to a specific block within the graph.
